shared_elements: large zoomorphic creature occupying the whole field
curvilinear scroll/spiral forms used for body parts or joints
limb-like curved appendages ending in hooked/clawed terminals
schematic head with a prominent rounded eye/boss
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single large curvilinear zoomorph whose limbs and joints resolve into hooked scrolls and spirals, with a rounded boss-like eye, which is a real if fairly broad stylistic correspondence. However, B depicts a legible quadruped with a small human figure above it holding a rein and is enclosed by a ruled geometric border, while A shows no human figure, no frame, and no readable single creature — its forms are an unbounded interlocking tangle spreading over the whole boulder.
